## 2.1 and 2.2 Headshot and Bio {#sec-headshot .unnumbered}

## Headshot {#sec-bio}
1. Background
- A plain background, an outdoor background, or a background that shows your work environment are all great options.

2. Expression
- Confident neutral expression or smile.

3. Lighting
- Make sure that lighting isn't shadow-y and that it is evenly distributed.

4. Framing
- Focus on face; shoulders and up can be included.

5. DIY Headshot
- Try to have a friend take your photo or set your phone up so that the 'selfie arm' is out of frame.

Here are a few great additional resources for taking a headshot

1. https://www.lsu.edu/career/blog/2026/01/howtoheadshots.php
2. https://www.nlalorphotography.com/blog/what-to-wear-for-corporate-headshots-women
